value.rationale: Fills the natural cycle gap left by the recent path-nilmanifold Poincaré theorem with an exact uniform lower bound. The bound grows with base 1+sqrt(5) even in wheel graphs of diameter two, exposing topology beyond the prior diameter-based universal bound. Its precise Lucas and parity terms arise from a nontrivial exact 25-state Euler calculation, not a routine small-case example.
